_comment: Manifest for api_bugfix_regression.yml. Bug-fix API tests live under tests/regression/ and run only here; api-testing.yml ignores tests/regression/ on every PR. Fields: label = job name `api_regression / <label>`; target = pytest args, relative to tests/api-testing; server_env = KEY=VALUE pairs the server starts with; category = the junit artifact category parse-api-junit.py reads. A file under tests/regression/ with no shard fails generate_matrix. Several shards may name one file only with different server_env (a flag matrix).

shards.label: default
shards._comment: Files that need no server env of their own.

shards.label: alerts_composite_sweep
shards._comment: openobserve#16664: a composite fires only on a sweep, and the 300 s default sweep would make its notify_failed wait up to 10 min.

shards.label: otlp_grpc_backpressure
shards._comment: A free-space requirement no runner meets keeps the disk circuit breaker tripped.

shards.label: sqlite_meta_invalid_utf8
shards._comment: Spawns and restarts its own server from the repo's debug binary.

shards.label: promql_mixed_case_name
shards._comment: openobserve#13926 only reproduces when stream names keep their case.

shards.label: multialert_notify_cap
shards._comment: openobserve#14407 needs a per-evaluation notification cap, which defaults to 0 (unlimited).

shards.label: wal_month_boundary
shards._comment: openobserve#16515 needs rows ~130 days old to stay in WAL parquet: quick memtable rotation, no upload for an hour.

shards.label: ingest_window_wide
shards._comment: openobserve#16422 seeds rows either side of the latest 30-day grid edges, up to 30 days + 4 h old; the workflow envs allow 48 h (OSS) and 5 h (ENT).

shards.label: streaming_aggs_cache
shards._comment: openobserve#16950 seeds rows 27 h old and needs the streaming-aggregation cache, which the planner skips for small data unless ZO_AGGS_MIN_NUM_PARTITIONS_SECS=0 and the rows reach the file list (ZO_MAX_FILE_RETENTION_TIME=10).

shards.label: uds_enabled
shards._comment: openobserve#16307 and openobserve#16861 only reproduce once a user-defined schema is saved, which needs the flag on; the #16861 file skips on OSS (service identity stamping is enterprise-only).

shards.label: skip_ssrf_checks
shards._comment: openobserve#16551: VRL network functions compile only with the SSRF checks skipped.

shards.label: streaming_aggs_limit
shards._comment: ENT#826 and ENT#571 only reproduce on the multi-partition streaming-aggs path: a 0s threshold, and files must leave the WAL because the planner sizes the query from the file list.

shards.label: tantivy_after_wal_flush
shards._comment: ENT#536 needs the rows to leave the WAL within the test: 10s WAL retention, 2s push, inverted index on.
